scope_limits: 两个数值变量、至多3轴、每轴最多8标签
只支持add/multiply，无插值与通用表达式
允许NumPy/xarray，输出需独立读回来源
input_policy: Given synthetic fixtures and any variants within the prompt-defined subset; invalid variants test only the declared rejection behavior.
quantifier: all inputs within the declared subset
non_goals: Anything outside the explicit subset is not an acceptance requirement.
